capacity_range_status: broad diagnostic only, not a measured or probabilistic source interval; never selects model
parameter_calibration: One cumulative TRAIN-camera gain per model. All source geometry/forcing scenarios retained.
limitations: One tower and one later calendar block; not independent glacier replication.
Observed evaluation surface-temperature forcing means a conditional hindcast, not a forecast of future weather.
Static ice/sensor geometry is assumed within source bounds; wet pore phase heat and geometry evolution are omitted.
Camera precision/reset semantics are not independently established; no confidence interval is inferred.
Air-temperature baseline has explicit linear interpolation across gaps up to 18 hours; this reconstructs missing forcing and is not fully native support.
Derivative OLS comparator is not the source NTLS or full professional energy-balance implementation.
One empirical training melt gain is not independently measured heat capacity or evidence of new physical laws.
